pmFiber.name: Stress-free Bent PMF / 2D-FBGE CPO Fiber Coupling Technology
pmFiber.description: Sumitomo Electric Technical Review No.96: stress-free bending PMF at R=2.2 mm showed PER >25 dB in the 0° bend direction and bending loss <0.1 dB. The 72-fiber D2-FBGE array has a 5.5 mm profile; the paper is a CPO coupling demonstration, not a product datasheet.
